verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: International health and telecommunication bodies, including the World Health Organization and the International Telecommunication Union, have confirmed there is no scientific evidence linking 5G technology to the spread of COVID-19. Viruses cannot travel on radio waves.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple Tier 1 sources, including the International Telecommunication Union (a UN agency), AFP Fact Check, and AP News, explicitly state there is no scientific basis for the claim that 5G is linked to COVID-19. They explain that viruses cannot travel on radio waves and that the pandemic also spread in countries without 5G networks. While one study (ws-7) found a statistical correlation between 5G presence and COVID-19 cases in the US, correlation does not imply causation. This single study is outweighed by the global scientific consensus and direct refutations from numerous expert bodies and fact-checkers.
